verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex ships AI features (AI-suggested modifications, AI-powered compliance support), so asking whether customer data can be kept out of model training is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no documented opt-out, data-use policy, or training-exclusion control. The AI feature mentions describe the capabilities only and say nothing about how training data is handled.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
